messages:
Emily (Partnerships): Heads-up — BlueSkyCloud's marketplace PO is blocked by AP. They keep rejecting the invoice because the line items don't match the marketplace SKU and the vendor is non-US (no EIN). Customer expects contract commit EOD. Can we escalate?
Mike (Finance): What's the exact rejection? If they're non-US they need a W-8 BEN-E. Also AP requires vendor legal name/address to match PO exactly.
Marketplace-AP-Bot: PO 987654321 ingestion failed — error INV_FORMAT_MISMATCH: 'invoice lines do not match marketplace SKU mapping'.
Lauren (Partner Ops): I'll reach out to the partner acct team now. Two common fixes: partner provides W-8 + bank details OR we do a reseller invoice flow (Redwood invoices BlueSky). Both need PO re-issuance or an addendum.
Sarah (Legal): Confirming: for non-US vendors we require W-8 BEN-E on file. Also flag: if we invoice as reseller we need a simple addendum to avoid downstream contract mismatch. I can draft a minimal addendum today.
Raj (Sales): We can't push this past EOD without risking the Q commit. Quick options: (A) Redwood invoices as reseller (fastest if partner agrees) (B) partner fixes invoice format and sends W-8 (likely 24–48h). Which gets done quicker?
BlueSky (Partner): We're working with our accounting team now. We can produce a W-8 BEN-E and update the invoice, but they require Redwood's tax info (EIN) to include on our invoice template.
Mike (Finance): Don't post EIN in public channels — I'll DM it. Realistically: if BlueSky sends a scanned W-8 + bank details to secure SFTP we can vendor-setup and process. If they refuse, AP will likely hold payment or apply withholding.
Emily (Partnerships): Is there a way for Partner Ops to remap the partner SKU -> marketplace SKU without partner re-issuing? Could be a quick config change?
Lauren (Partner Ops): The marketplace UI allows SKU mapping but it still requires the partner to accept the mapped invoice. That acceptance step currently can't be bypassed for legal reasons. Mapping itself I can do in ~2 hours. Acceptance is with partner.
Sarah (Legal): If time is the blocker, I'll prepare the reseller addendum language and we can get an e-signature today. That reduces the partner effort (they won't need to change invoice lines). We still need a W-8 for tax records.
Raj (Sales): Ok let's pursue both in parallel: Lauren do mapping, Sarah draft addendum, Mike be ready to fast-track vendor onboarding once W-8 lands, Emily coordinate BlueSky's accounting. I'll hold the customer messaging until we know.
Mike (Finance): Checklist to send BlueSky now: 1) Signed W-8 BEN-E, 2) Vendor legal name & address EXACT as on PO, 3) Bank details (ABA/Swift), 4) Remittance contact email. If they send those to secure SFTP I'll expedite.
BlueSky (Partner): Sending W-8 + bank info now to the secure SFTP link — ETA 30m. Can you confirm who will sign the addendum if needed?
Sarah (Legal): I'll own the addendum signature from our side. If BlueSky needs a PO-side contact, @Emily please confirm the partner signer.
Emily (Partnerships): I'll confirm partner signer and ping them to sign. Also @Lauren please confirm SKU mapping by 14:30 PST so we know if mapping avoids addendum. :pray:
Lauren (Partner Ops): Confirmed — I'll have mapping done by 14:30 PST and ping BlueSky to accept.
Marketplace-AP-Bot: PO 987654321 status changed to ESCALATED by @Emily.
Emily (Partnerships): Thanks team — next steps tracked: Lauren (mapping), Sarah (addendum), Mike (vendor setup), Raj (customer comms), Emily (partner coordination). I'll update thread when BlueSky confirms upload.
Mike (Finance): If we get the W-8 within the hour we can complete vendor setup today and avoid withholding.
Raj (Sales): I'll standby. If we still miss EOD commit I'll prepare a short customer note offering a one-day extension and explaining AP paperwork delay.
BlueSky (Partner): W-8 and bank details uploaded. Please confirm receipt and next steps.
Emily (Partnerships): Received. @Mike please confirm once you pick it up.
Mike (Finance): Got it — starting vendor setup now. ETA 3 hours for processing unless more issues pop up.
Lauren (Partner Ops): Mapping done and partner notified to accept the mapped invoice.
Sarah (Legal): Draft addendum in flight; will share for quick review in #legal-review.
Emily (Partnerships): This is moving. Thanks everyone for jumping on it. :thumbsup:
